title: Benchmarking AlphaGenome through a reanalysis of the 1p13 SORT1 cholesterol locus: derived analysis tables
description: Four large derived AlphaGenome output tables supporting Figures 3A, 4H and 4J. File identities, sizes, SHA-256 digests and regeneration scripts are recorded in the accompanying SORT1-reanalysis repository.
notes: Access-right and license fields must be set only after AlphaGenome prediction-redistribution terms are confirmed.
